turns.question: It's the end of 7 October 2026. How many customers who signed up in 2026 have never placed an order?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for customers who have never placed an order, and I will not subtract one count from another myself. The closest metrics are Signups (customers who signed up in the period), Active customers (distinct customers with at least one non-cancelled order, which leaves out customers whose only orders were cancelled) and the Signup-to-first-order rate (share of customers who placed a first order within 30 days of signing up).
